system.description:
Elephant Seal Curiots are large, bulbous, and gelatinous. They are also extremely powerful, and low to the ground in weight distribution.

Size: Medium (6.5–8 feet) · Lifespan: Typically 65–85 years

Abilities: @UUID[Compendium.sacadia.cultures.Item.9d9dc8a6c8600c32]{Brutish Figure}

Myrgha ancestry. Curiot Heritage. Rulebook p.31.
